'''Mariya Ise''' (Japanese: '''伊瀬茉莉也''' ''Ise Mariya'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Ise was born on September 25, 1988, in {{wp|Kanagawa Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} shortly before {{aniseries|XY}}. Her most notable role is {{an|Bonnie}}. From [[XY086]] to [[XY100]], she took a {{wp|Parental leave|maternity leave}} while expecting her child to be born; during that time, [[Mika Kanai]] temporarily replaced her to voice Bonnie.<ref>https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2015-09-05/hunter-x-hunter-actress-mariya-ise-safely-gives-birth-to-1st-child/.92369</ref> Ise is currently affiliated with the entertainment office {{wp|Across Entertainment}}.
